turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So what brings you here today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I've had this cough, ongoing now for the last three days and I found I've had a more difficult time breathing as well.

turns.text: OK, and So what came first? did the cough come first?

turns.text: OK and so it started three days ago?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: When did the shortness of breath start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That started probably about two days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and the cough, can you describe it a little bit? Is it like a wet cough, a dry cough? How would you describe it?

turns.text: Yeah, I brought up a little bit of sputum. It's been clear, mostly clear and sometimes dry as well. The cough's been getting worse over the last couple of days as well and hasn't really stopped either, it's just kind of ongoing all day.

turns.text: OK, so it's it's pretty constant?

turns.text: OK, and how much sputum would you say you're bringing up?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is your sputum at all yellow, green? Or does it have any blood tinge content in it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't noticed anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so it's mainly just white or clear.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it's mostly, yeah, like whiteish or clear.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and have you had anything like this happen before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how would you describe the shortness of breath? Are you having trouble taking deep breaths or are you having trouble breathing when exerting yourself, like how would you describe it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I have like, a chest tightness. I find when I exert myself it gets worse and after I cough, I have a little bit of trouble catching my breath as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, When do you have the chest tightness, when did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, that's started within the last two days as well, with the cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so is it just the tightness when you cough or is it there just throughout?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah if I take like a deep breath in, like, it just feels tight, like I can't get a deep breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any kind of, like swelling in your calves, or pain in your calves at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any surgeries recently or have you been immobilized for a long time or admitted to a hospital or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had anything like that, I've been healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had anything like a blood clot, either in your legs or traveling up to your lungs in the past before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you been diagnosed with cancer or any other medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK uhm, so would you say the coughing and the shortness of breath is getting worse, or it's about the same?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'd say it's gotten a little bit worse over these last couple of days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is there anything that makes your symptoms better or worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, if I exert myself it does make it a bit worse. It'll bring on the cough more, and shortness of breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how about any positional changes? Like, does lying down help? Does resting help relieve some of that tightness, cough and shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that has helped.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you tried any kind of medications at all, over the counter?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't tried anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, so it seems that your shortness of breath, is it, uh, mainly when you're breathing in or breathing out? Or are you having shallow breaths? How would you describe it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say it, yeah, I kind of go back to the chest tightness, it just feels like I'm not able to, like, breath in all the way and catch my breath after I exert myself or coughing. It's easy Uh, like if I rest I'm not short of breath.

turns.text: OK, do you have any other symptoms? like a runny nose, sore throat? Anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, nothing like that.

turns.text: OK, and any headaches?

turns.label: Patient

turns.text: OK, and is it like a different type of headache and is it on one side of your head or both?

turns.text: Yeah, I feel it on both, kinda like right up into my forehead there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is it kind of like a pressure like pain? Is it pulsating pain? How would you describe it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say it's more of a pressure, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, have you tried any medications for it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, Yeah, I took an Advil this morning. It's taken the edge off a little bit. I will use that sometimes when I get headaches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you having any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't had anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you traveled outside of the country or outside of the province at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you been in contact with anyone that's been sick recently?

turns.text: I don't think so. I work at the Toyota factory and there have been a few people that have been sick who worked there? But I don't think I've been in contact with them.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and are you having any fevers or chills at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I have felt pretty hot, yeah, I was sweaty last night, I didn't check a temperature, but I felt feverish.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, were you having night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: My bed wasn't drenched or anything but I was sweating.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK are you feeling like you have lost any sense of taste or smell at all?

turns.text: OK, and when did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That may be within the last two days as well.

turns.label: Clinician

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't have anything like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, yeah, any changes in your bowel movements, like any Constipation or diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when did this start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, probably like last night, this morning when I was laying down and just felt a bit tired and achy?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Has your sleep or appetite changed at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I didn't sleep very good last night. I just don't feel very rested this morning. And yeah, I haven't felt very hungry either.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, alright, do you have any medical conditions that you take any medications for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't take any medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any surgeries or have been hospitalized before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did have tubes in my ears when I was little, but that's it though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any family history of any heart or lung conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, my dad had a triple bypass surgery done last last year. He was sixty-three at the time and that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you don't have any high blood pressure or anything like that, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, just environmental stuff I think, just, like in the springtime, I'll get itchy eyes or a runny nose.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and currently do you work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I do, yeah I work at a car factory nearby, just on the assembly line.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you been off of work right now, with your symptoms? How is that going?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, just like these last two days I called in and I let them know and I left work early yesterday when I realized that I was feeling sick and didn't go in this morning.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, and what's your living situation like?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I live with my girlfriend, and we have a son who's four years old.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any one of them having any similar symptoms?
